title: Infinitesimal deformations of $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ with a twisted Jacobi identity
summary: We show that whenever \[ [\,\cdot,\cdot]_t = [\,\cdot,\cdot]_0 + t[\,\cdot,\cdot]_1,\qquad α_t = \mathrm{id} + tα_1 \] define an infinitesimal Hom--Lie deformation of $\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb K)$ over $\mathbb K[t]/(t^2)$ and $(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb K),[\,\cdot,\cdot]_0,α_1)$ is a Hom--Lie algebra, then the deformed bracket $[\,\cdot,\cdot]_t$ satisfies the ordinary Jacobi identity over $\mathbb K[t]$. This solves a conjecture of Makhlouf and Silvestrov from 2010.
